title: CondUQ: Calibrated Conditional Uncertainty Quantification Using Distribution Matching
abstract: arXiv:2611.33939v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many applications, especially reliability- and safety-critical ones, require accurate uncertainty quantification for the outputs of model- or learning-based measurement, estimation, and prediction systems. The errors of such systems often vary with factors such as input quality and operating conditions, and thus cannot be accurately described by a single Gaussian model. Although Gaussian mixture models and calibrated quantiles can approximate such error distributions, their unconditional forms do not capture how the error behavior depends on these factors. Hence, we propose condUQ, an approach that conditions error models on observable factors for enabling accurate and reliable uncertainty quantification. condUQ is built on top of an existing system without modifying it and applies even when the system is a black box. translated_title: CondUQ：基于分布匹配的校准条件不确定性量化
translated_abstract: 许多应用，尤其是可靠性和安全性关键的应用，需要对基于模型或学习的测量、估计和预测系统的输出进行准确的不确定性量化。此类系统的误差往往随输入质量和运行条件等因素变化，因此无法用单一的 高斯模型准确描述。尽管高斯混合模型和校准分位数可以近似此类误差分布，但它们的无条件形式无法捕捉误差行为对这些因素的依赖关系。因此，我们提出了 condUQ，一种将误差模型条件化于可观测因素的方法，以实现准确可靠的不确定性量化。condUQ 构建于现有系统之上而无需修改该系统，即使系统是黑盒也能适用。首先，condUQ 将可观测因素映射到一个潜在的质量指数，使得共享相同 QI 的误差服从相同的分布……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 condUQ 方法，通过将误差模型条件化于可观测因素（如输入质量和运行条件）进行分布匹配，在不修改甚至黑盒的现有系统之上实现准确可靠的条件不确定性量化。
en_tdlr: condUQ conditions error models on observable factors via distribution matching, enabling accurate and reliable uncertainty quantification on top of unmodified—even black-box—existing systems.
